Metadata.title: Eau de Fragrances — your perfume collection
Metadata.description: Catalogue the perfumes you own, keep a wishlist of what to buy next, and see each scent's Parfumo rating and notes.

Home.title: Every bottle you own. Every bottle you want.
Home.subtitle: Catalogue your perfume collection, keep a wishlist of what to buy next, and see the rating and notes of every scent, straight from Parfumo.
Home.featuresTitle: Built for the way collectors think

collection.title: Your collection
collection.body: Every bottle in one place, with concentration, year and your own rating.

wishlist.title: Wishlist
wishlist.body: Save what you want to try or buy next, then move it to your collection the day it arrives.

ratings.title: Ratings, notes and pictures
ratings.body: Every perfume shows its Parfumo rating, its top, heart and base notes, and a bottle picture, filled in automatically from the link.

prices.title: Prices in Bulgaria
prices.body: Compare a perfume's prices across Bulgarian online shops in one click, through Pazaruvaj.

showcase.label: Well-known perfumes
showcase.open: {name} on Parfumo (opens in a new tab)
